caption: AI outputs can look perfect while still being wrong. These five checks help you verify AI-generated work. Do you fact-check AI output before publishing? #AI #Productivity #DecisionMaking #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: Reality: AI checks miss context
slides.body: AI outputs can misstate facts, cite errors, or omit nuance. Here are five prompts to verify and improve AI-generated work.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose accuracy
slides.body: Cross-check claims with reliable sources. Input: {{text}} Output: verified_claims with source_list.

slides.title: 2. Improve clarity
slides.body: Rephrase vague sentences for precision. Input: {{text}} Output: rewritten_text with clarity_score (0-1).

slides.title: 3. Apply citations
slides.body: Add missing citations and date ranges. Input: {{text}} Output: text_with_citations.

slides.title: 4. Check bias and gaps
slides.body: Identify bias risk and coverage gaps. Input: {{text}} Output: bias_gaps_report.

slides.title: 5. Build workflow
slides.body: Create a repeatable QA workflow you can reuse. Output: YAML_template with steps.

slides.title: Takeaway: Verify AI work
slides.body: Make verification a habit. A solid QA before sharing saves time and risk.
